Class LessonTestingAutomation

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.LessonTestingAutomation
public class LessonTestingAutomation extends Object

Title: LessonTestingAutomation Class.

Description: A semi-automated test driver, in the style of the InputValidationTestingAutomation class, that performs every test case in the HW2 Test Cases.pdf (TC-01 through TC-23) for the lessons learned Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations and their input validation. Each test prints the test case ID from the PDF, so the console output can be matched to the document line by line. Unlike the input validation tests, these tests need a database. They use the Database(String dbUrl) constructor with private in-memory H2 databases, so they never alter the production database. The persistence test (TC-23) uses a temporary database file instead, because persistence can only be shown by closing a connection and opening a new one.
